scoring_justification: Absolute d-band center values depend on DFT implementation details; scoring structural inequalities (range broadening, element-specific range thresholds, overall span) rather than exact value matching.

hidden_assets.purpose: Thresholds for structural inequalities derived from the paper's reported d-band center ranges (Figure 3 and text).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper JACS 2022, 144, 3365-3369: monometallic Pt ε_d range -2.37 to -2.57 eV (range 0.20 eV); NM-HEA Pt range -2.07 to -3.46 eV (range 1.39 eV); overall NM-HEA surface ε_d span approximately -3.4 to -2.0 eV.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's narrative and Figure 3; broadened thresholds (+/-0.3 eV for overall span) and factor 1.2 for broadening adopted from the approved plan's verification method.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All thresholds are grounded in the paper's reported quantities and the planned tolerances; no synthetic gold numbers were invented.

outputs.description: Table of every surface atom's local d-band center. The checker recomputes per-element ranges from this CSV and verifies required structural relationships (range broadening, overall span).
Aggregated summary of epsilon_d ranges. The checker may validate structure and consistency with the CSV, but primary scoring is based on recomputation from the CSV.

output_contract.notes: The workflow covers only the DFT-based d-band center analysis. Experimental spectra, HER activity, LDOS profile shape comparisons, and supervised learning regression are excluded per the defined scope. The agent must produce both artifacts; scoring is weighted primarily on the CSV via recomputed structural inequalities.

steps.description: Recompute per-element epsilon_d ranges from the raw CSV and verify three structural relations: (1) for each of the 8 elements, NMHEA range > 1.2 * monometallic range; (2) Pt NMHEA range > 1.0 eV AND Pt monometallic range < 0.5 eV; (3) overall NMHEA surface epsilon_d min ≤ -3.1 eV AND max ≥ -2.3 eV. Reward is a weighted average of these checks (broadening 0.4, Pt 0.3, span 0.3).
Validate that the JSON summary contains the required keys and that its values match the recomputed per-element ranges from the CSV within 0.01 eV absolute tolerance.
